title: Rochdale research centre moves closer to opening with £107m economic ambition
excerpt: The Sustainable Materials and Manufacturing Centre at Kingsway Business Park has completed its main building, with specialist fit-out ahead of a planned 2027 opening.
body:
A new Rochdale facility designed to help turn scientific discoveries into commercial products has reached a construction milestone, ahead of a planned opening in 2027.

The main building of the Sustainable Materials and Manufacturing Centre, at Kingsway Business Park, is now complete. Specialist equipment and facilities will be installed before it becomes operational.

The centre will support work on advanced materials with potential applications in medicine, electronics and construction, helping researchers test whether ideas developed in laboratories can become practical products.

Scientists and businesses will work with the University of Manchester and specialist innovation partners, connecting research expertise with the facilities needed to develop and manufacture new technologies.

The 30,000 sq ft centre is the first major physical development within the Atom Valley Innovation District, bringing researchers, manufacturers and investors together in Rochdale.

Independent analysis cited by the project’s partners forecasts £107 million in economic value over ten years, alongside opportunities to attract investment, businesses and skilled employment. That figure is a forecast, rather than income already generated.

Professor John Holden, the University of Manchester’s vice-president for civic engagement and innovation, said the next challenge was to connect the building with businesses, research and expertise to create lasting benefits.

For Rochdale, the centre represents a step towards establishing a larger advanced manufacturing sector—although its laboratories are still being prepared for the work ahead.

Sources: University of Manchester project announcement: https://www.manchester.ac.uk/about/news/major-milestone-for-atom-valley-as-sustainable-materials--manufacturing-centre-base-build-completes/ Additional reporting and project details: https://www.themanufacturer.com/articles/sustainable-materials-manufacturing-centre-takes-shape-in-rochdale/

corrections.note: The headline has been corrected to distinguish completion of the main building from the centre’s planned operational opening in 2027. The £107 million economic forecast covers ten years.
